notes.title: Battleship Gameplay Update
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

We are really excited to share a new gameplay mechanics of a Battleship class vessel gameplay!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37688583/a14c4e0f4e8f5b583fb32703bf2014f315e97c7e.png

Commanding a Battleship in space brings a whole new perspective to the gameplay. Equipped with heavy weaponry and a fighter bay systems, this vessel is a force to reckon with. The systems are governed by the requisition points that are being generated over time, can be gained by destroying enemy ships and completing objectives.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37688583/bcdd2e99fb6869ae61988293c184d77d1d54cd6c.png

Additionally, there are doctrines available to switch between while commanding a Battleship. The combat doctrine enables the use of heavy long range cannons designed to counter large enemy crafts. While the tactical doctrine increases the generation rate of requisition points, to enable a more frequent use of special abilities, like calling in fighters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37688583/2cbbccd057ad720ed1cdee406d7c3d035035d684.png

notes.title: Aphelion - Fighter Class Ships
notes.content:
Fighter Class Ships

Aphelion offers many different space ships for you to command, and fighters are one of them. These small, agile ships come in large verity and suited for all types of combat. The fighter class hulls are capable of holding small and standard size modules, and come equipped with multiple types of weapon hard-points to mount your guns.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37688583/cf52da07757c61360689ba38f0ec24a6e1d9401b.png

Fighter class hulls weapon hard-points are equipped to mount primary and secondary weapon types, allowing for versatile configurations for different types of engagements. Some fighter class hulls come equipped for specialized weapon types, such as heavy rail cannons and pulse cannons, making them more suitable for hunting down larger ship classes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37688583/8bbe9576aa54a85988dd2ded8d3a92a2a4c51235.png

New fighter class hulls, modules and weapons will become available to you, as you progress through the story-line and unlock new technologies.

notes.title: Calling All Pilots
notes.content:
Welcome to the Frontier

Hello all!

We at Evil Bunneh are happy to announce that Aphelion – Frontier Chronicles, our new upcoming space combat simulator, will become available later this year. We will be announcing the release date in the next few weeks.

We are very excited to share the development progress with you and will be posting updated with in game content regularly as well as talking about the direction we are taking and the features we plan to have on release and in later updates.

The Federation needs you
We at Evil Bunneh are looking forward to hearing your feedback and ideas. Please feel welcomed to post your questions and discuss the game features with us on the community hub:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1308630/discussions/

We believe that this is going to be very exciting experience for us to get the community involved in the development process.


Thank you,
Evil Bunneh Team.
